name: DCA-SYS-02 · Setup Checker & Install Guide (run this first)

parameters.content:
## 🧰 Setup Checker — run this FIRST
**One run → everything still wrong, with the fix for each.**

### How to use it
1. Import every template you plan to use.
2. Fill in their **⚙️ Config** nodes.
3. Come back here, open **⚙️ Config**, and enter the same values you used
   in the others.
4. Press **Execute**. Read **📋 Setup report**.
5. Fix what it lists, run again until it is clean.

### Why this exists
Roughly **70% of templates fail at install** — not because the workflow is
wrong, but because one small step was missed and the failure shows up
hours later somewhere unrelated.

This is the closest thing to someone looking over your shoulder.

### 🔑 The check that matters most
**Four templates share one link-signing secret:**
`A1-01` mints · `A1-02` verifies · `A4-01` reissues · `A1-04` broadcasts.

If any two disagree, **every download fails** with an "invalid signature"
error that looks like tampering rather than a typo.

That is brutal to diagnose from the inside. So this actually **computes a
signature with each secret and compares them** — it does not trust that
you pasted the same string four times.

### 📊 Severity order
| Level | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 🔴 **blocker** | customers will hit this today |
| 🟠 **important** | works now, will bite you |
| 🟡 **advisable** | best practice, not urgent |
| ✅ **passed** | confirmed working |

Fix every 🔴 before pointing real traffic at anything.

### 🔁 Run it again after any change
Rotated a secret · added a template · changed a Config value · moved from
test to live.

It takes three seconds and catches the mistake before a customer does.

nodes.name: ▶️ Run the setup check
nodes.notes: Use this to dry-run the workflow before you point real traffic at it.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config
nodes.notes: Copy the real values from your other templates' Config nodes. Be honest about the booleans — this only helps if it reflects reality.

nodes.name: 🔬 Build the signature probe
nodes.notes: One fixed payload, signed with each configured secret.

nodes.name: 🔏 Sign with A1-01 secret
nodes.notes: Signs the probe with the secret you pasted from A1-01.

nodes.name: 🔏 Sign with A1-02 secret
nodes.notes: Signs the same probe with A1-02's secret. These two must match.

nodes.name: 🔏 Sign with A4-01 secret
nodes.notes: A4-01 reissues links, so its secret must match too.

nodes.name: 🔏 Sign with A1-04 secret
nodes.notes: A1-04 broadcasts fresh links, so its secret must match as well.

nodes.name: 🔎 Run every check
nodes.notes: Every finding names the node to open and what to type. Ordered by severity.

nodes.name: 📋 Setup report
nodes.notes: Open this node's output and read it. The top line tells you whether you can go live.

nodes.name: 📨 Email the report
nodes.notes: Optional — the report is readable in the previous node's output. Attach SMTP if you want it emailed.

nodes.name: 📒 Check outcome
nodes.notes: Captures the result even if the optional email fails.
